title: Keeps messing with my BT
body:
I installed this again, love this app! Unfortunately it keeps shutting off my blue tooth, Samsung 6+ (I know this because it disconnects my G3 watch when my phone is right next to me) next thing Is that my phone can't get readings from my G5 transmitter. Disconnected for about 2 weeks and used the nearly stupid "pocket buddy" that came with the G5. At least it works. But it's like driving a Kia when your used to a Cadillac.
I'll wait a couple more weeks and see if these issues are fixed, finally. This all started about 4 weeks ago.

comments.body: Have you tried the `Less Common Settings` -> `Bluetooth Settings` and disable the ability for xDrip to toggle bluetooth?
@Tesummerill Do you still have this problem?  If not, would you please close this issue?
